main_text.l: definentia, vel sunt masculina, vel foe-
minina, vel communia: in ον vero, sunt
neutra, ut: ὁ λαὸς, ἡ νόσ⊖, ὁ κ⊖ ἡ ἀνθρώπ⊖: τὸ
& ρ⊖ definentia, communia sunt. ut: ὁ χ⊖ ἡ φιλόσοφ⊖, ἀρχ⊖ς. ἄστ⊖, γνώσ⊖, ἀ-φόρ⊖.
abjiciunt. ut: τὸ ἄλλο, & composita cum ⊖ ⊖;
Genitivus, definit in ς, ut: τῆς λόγος,
Dativus, in ῳ. ut: τῷ λόγῳ, τῷ ξύλῳ.
Accusativus, in ον. ut: τὸν λόγον, τὸ ξύλον.
Vocativus, in ε, à Nominativo in ⊖;
vel in ον, à Nominativo neutro. ut: ὦ λόγ⊖,
& Vocativus, definunt in ω. ut: τὼ λόγω, ξύλω.

page.notes: Greek and some ligatured or symbol glyphs (⊖ for abbreviation signs) are approximated; the page is faded at edges. Catchword "liqui," appears at the foot right and is included as the last line.
